title: Tiberian Sun Music for Red Alert
description:
[h1]Tiberian Sun Music[/h1]

Tiberian Sun and Firestorm's soundtrack for Red Alert. Built for Command & Conquer Remastered Collection.

This is an asset pack: on its own it adds nothing to the game. A mod has to use it.

[h2]Playing Tiberian Factions[/h2]

With this pack enabled beside [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3729834253]Tiberian Factions[/url], its tracks join the skirmish music and the jukebox. Without it, Tiberian Factions plays its usual music.

[h2]Using the music in your own mod[/h2]

Enable this pack beside your mod: the game finds its WAVs in any enabled mod. Name them in your mod's Data/XML/AUDIO/MUSICEVENTS.XML playlists, and for the jukebox add an entry per track to <MusicJukeboxTracksList> in AUDIO_SYSTEM_CONSTANTS.XML, with its title in your ModText.csv.

[h2]Contents[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Tiberian Sun:[/b] the 18 in-game themes, from Valves to Pharotek
[*][b]Firestorm:[/b] the 8 in-game themes, from Elusive to Deploy Machines
[*]Each as a Remastered music WAV (TS_MUS_<TITLE>.WAV)

[/list]
[h2]AI disclosure[/h2]

No AI made or changed the music: these are the original tracks, converted. The scripts that build this pack were written with AI assistance.

[h2]Credits[/h2]

Original Tiberian Sun and Firestorm music: Westwood Studios and Electronic Arts.
Converted for Remastered by gibbo101.
